label: Undercutting all available supporting bases precludes target warrant (inference)
rule: Eliminate the undefeated-basis witness by identifying it with the undercut basis
meaning: If the subject had warrant for the target, the warrant condition supplies an undefeated supporting basis. Sole-basis dependence identifies it with the undercut basis, contradiction. Take the target to be the accepted package for conditional self-undermining; no truth or general epistemic nihilism conclusion follows.
